description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 2] and [ATK, MAG and MND +30% (25s)], grants [Protean Mode (Fire, Ice, Earth, Wind)], [Awoken Mimicry Magic], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Mimicked Salvation Mode] to the user

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 2
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next two attacks

description.name: Protean Mode (Fire, Ice, Earth, Wind)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Earth]/[Attach Wind] after using a Fire/Ice/Earth/Wind ability

description.name: Awoken Mimicry Magic
description.text: Black Magic abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Black Magic abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies after using Black Magic abilities

description.name: Mimicked Salvation Mode
description.text: Mimicked abilities deal 50% more damage, casts the last ability used by any ally when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed, grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to user when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed, removed after triggering three times
